description: Tako is a data visualization and research platform. Send natural-language queries and get citation-backed, real-time knowledge cards — interactive, embeddable, source-attributed representations of real data. Tako pulls from authoritative government, academic, think-tank, and licensed providers (not scraped web content), so agents can ground answers in trustworthy data.

data_domains.name: Company financials
data_domains.coverage: Public & private company financials, revenue, earnings, valuations, M&A, and fundamentals (S&P Global and other providers)

data_domains.name: Market data
data_domains.coverage: Real-time and historical stock, commodity, and cryptocurrency prices

data_domains.name: Web & digital analytics
data_domains.coverage: Website traffic, engagement, and competitive benchmarking (SimilarWeb)

data_domains.name: Economics & macro
data_domains.coverage: GDP, inflation, trade, employment, and other macroeconomic indicators from government and institutional sources

data_domains.name: Political & elections
data_domains.coverage: Public opinion polling (YouGov), geopolitical indicators, and political trends

data_domains.name: Prediction markets
data_domains.coverage: Real-time odds and forecasts from major platforms like Polymarket

data_domains.name: Weather & climate
data_domains.coverage: Current conditions, forecasts, and historical weather (NOAA / NWS)

data_domains.name: Sports
data_domains.coverage: Scores, standings, player stats, and records — NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAAF, EPL, Champions League, Bundesliga, La Liga, Ligue 1, Serie A, F1, and more

data_domains.name: Demographics & social
data_domains.coverage: Population, census, health, education, and quality-of-life indicators

endpoints.description: Search across Tako data and the web
Answer a question with cited synthesis
Download the content behind a search result
Visualize your own data (inline CSV); does not search Tako's data
Create a ThinViz card from components
Poll status for report generation (free, receipt-authenticated)
Run a deep-research agent (multi-step research, async)
Poll status for an agent run (free, receipt-authenticated)
Edit a chart using a natural language prompt
